style: Candid documentary photography, natural UK daylight, warm and grounded, shallow depth of field, 35mm look, subtle film grain. Palette leans cream, warm wood, cobalt blue accents. No logos, no legible screen text or UI, no watermarks, no robots or sci-fi effects. Real, ordinary, credible people. Illustrative scene: not Promonet staff or clients.

cast.ownerA: Jo, a woman in her early 40s who runs an independent bicycle repair workshop in a UK town; shoulder-length dark-blonde hair tied back, navy work apron over a grey t-shirt, practical and friendly
cast.ownerB: Dev, a British-Indian man in his early 50s who runs a small garden-design business from a converted garage office; short greying hair, neat beard, olive-green quarter-zip jumper
cast.consultant: Sam, a relaxed, friendly man in his mid-30s, short brown hair, light stubble, cobalt-blue crewneck knit, in a tidy home office with plants and a bookshelf

ai_ready.musicPrompt: Warm, modern, optimistic instrumental for a 30-second small-business ad. Soft plucked synth, gentle piano, light brushed percussion, steady 100 bpm, unobtrusive under a voiceover, clean ending.

beats.vo: Are you AI-ready? More and more customers ask AI to recommend a local business.
caption: Are you AI-ready?
Customers now ask AI for recommendations
beats.still: A young woman in a cosy UK living room sits on a sofa holding her phone up near her face, speaking a question into it, phone screen facing away from camera, warm lamp light, evening. Vertical frame, subject in lower two thirds, clear space at top.
beats.motion: She speaks into the phone naturally then glances at the screen, waiting for an answer. Slow gentle push-in. Natural hand movement.

beats.vo: But can AI bots actually find your website, and understand what you do?
caption: Can AI bots find your website?
And understand what you do?
beats.still: ownerA stands at a wooden workbench in her bike workshop, bicycles and tools hanging on the wall behind, looking at an open laptop on the bench with a thoughtful, slightly concerned expression. Laptop screen angled away. Soft window light. Vertical frame.
beats.motion: She leans in toward the laptop, scrolls with one finger on the trackpad, frowns slightly. Subtle handheld camera drift.

beats.vo: We check what they can access, what they can understand, and how clearly your business comes across.
caption: Can they access it?
Understand it?
Is your business clear?
beats.still: Over-the-shoulder close shot of ownerA at the workbench, hands on a laptop keyboard, a bike wheel and a mug of tea beside it, laptop screen softly out of focus with no legible content. Warm light, shallow depth of field. Vertical frame.
beats.motion: Her hands type briefly then pause; she nods slowly. Slow lateral camera slide.

beats.vo: We're Promonet. A small business, helping small businesses.
caption: Promonet
A small business helping small businesses
beats.still: consultant sits at his home office desk smiling warmly toward a laptop webcam as if greeting someone on a video call, one hand raised in a small friendly wave, plants and bookshelf behind, daylight. Laptop screen not visible. Vertical frame.
beats.motion: He waves, smiles and starts talking in a relaxed way, small natural hand gestures. Locked camera with very slight push-in.

beats.vo: Book a free thirty-minute AI evaluation call, and leave with three clear next steps.
caption: Free 30-minute AI evaluation
3 clear next steps
beats.still: ownerA at the workbench on a video call on her laptop, smiling and writing in a small notebook with a blue pen, bikes behind her, warm afternoon light. Laptop screen angled away. Vertical frame.
beats.motion: She nods, laughs lightly, and writes a short note in the notebook. Gentle push-in.

beats.vo: Real people. Plain English. No obligation.
caption: Real people. Plain English.
No obligation.
beats.still: ownerA standing in the open doorway of her bike workshop on a UK high street, arms folded, relaxed confident smile, a bicycle leaning beside her, golden late-afternoon light. Vertical frame with clear space in the upper third.
beats.motion: She smiles at the camera and gives a small nod. Slow pull-back.

connect_tools.musicPrompt: Light, hopeful, modern instrumental for a 30-second small-business ad. Starts slightly busy and repetitive with ticking percussion, then resolves into a warm, flowing groove with soft keys. 104 bpm, unobtrusive under voiceover, clean ending.

beats.vo: Do your tools talk to each other?
caption: Do your tools
talk to each other?
beats.still: ownerB at a cluttered desk in a converted garage office, a laptop, a phone, a printed spreadsheet and many sticky notes around him, rubbing his forehead, tired expression, garden plans pinned on the wall behind. Daylight from a side window. Vertical frame.
beats.motion: He exhales, rubs his forehead and looks from the phone to the laptop. Subtle handheld drift.

beats.vo: Or are you copying the same details from your inbox, to a spreadsheet, to your CRM, again and again?
caption: Inbox → spreadsheet → CRM
Again. And again.
beats.still: Close-up of ownerB's hands: one holding a phone, the other typing on a laptop keyboard, sticky notes stuck around the laptop edge, a printed sheet with a highlighter. Screens out of focus, no legible text. Vertical frame.
beats.motion: He glances at the phone, types, glances again, types again, a repetitive rhythm. Locked camera.

beats.vo: When your tools don't talk, you become the connection.
caption: When your tools don't talk,
you become the connection.
beats.still: ownerB leans back in his desk chair with his hands behind his head, looking at the ceiling, frustrated but good-humoured, laptop and paperwork in front of him. Medium shot, vertical frame.
beats.motion: He leans back, sighs and lets his arms drop. Slow push-in.

beats.vo: We connect them, so the work flows on its own.
caption: We connect them.
The work flows on its own.
beats.still: consultant focused at his home office desk, working on a laptop with a notebook of hand-drawn boxes and arrows beside it, calm confident expression, daylight, plants behind. Laptop screen not visible. Vertical frame.
beats.motion: He types, then draws an arrow in the notebook and gives a small satisfied nod. Slow lateral slide.

beats.vo: Real humans, hands-on, working directly with you.
caption: Real humans. Hands-on.
Working directly with you.
beats.still: consultant and ownerB sitting side by side at ownerB's garage office desk, consultant pointing at the laptop (screen angled away) while ownerB smiles and nods, mugs of tea, relaxed collaborative mood. Vertical frame.
beats.motion: They talk, ownerB laughs and nods, consultant gestures at the laptop. Gentle push-in.

beats.vo: And because AI makes building software faster, simple connections start from three hundred and fifty pounds. Book your free thirty-minute call.
caption: AI makes building faster
Simple connections from £350
beats.still: ownerB outside in a client's well-kept back garden holding a tablet under one arm and a mug of tea, relaxed smile, sunny afternoon, plants and a stone path. Vertical frame with clear space in the upper third.
beats.motion: He sips his tea, looks around the garden contentedly, and smiles. Slow pull-back.
